|Hr = Journal
|Rag-winged adult crawbug bearing a scavenged pin.<hr />Far more hostile than their younger companions but seemingly less likely to roam far from their nest.}}

<b>Tallcraws</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are lanky, pin-wielding [[Craws|crawbugs]] with shawl-like wings.

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
A Tallcraw sits in place until angered, at which point it either flies into the air or hops around on the ground, preparing for an attack. It occasionally switches between its grounded and aerial states, both of which have different attacks.

The Tallcraw has 5 attacks:

* <b>Jab:</b> Performs a short jab at Hornet.
* <b>Dash:</b> Raises its pin before performing a long dash at Hornet, covering much more area.
* <b>Arcing Slashes:</b> The Tallcraw hops into the air, spinning its pin around itself repeatedly. If caught in this attack, it comboes Hornet for {{Damage|1+1}}.
* <b>Aerial Jab:</b> The Tallcraw flies into position above Hornet before pointing its pin downwards, trying to drop down on top of her.
* <b>Aerial Dash:</b> The Tallcraw raises its pin towards Hornet before dashing straight at her, bouncing off the first surface it hits. The angle of the dash is not static and changes so that they go in a straight line towards Hornet.

Tallcraws deal {{Damage|1}} on contact and with all attacks except Arcing Slashes.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Tallcraws have their health doubled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== Location ==
Tallcraws are exclusively found in eastern [[Greymoor]] near Craw Lake.
